description: crate-jmap-contacts-server/AGENTS.md prominently calls out the canonical-template rule, with the propagation direction stated explicitly: change canonical first, then propagate. This is critical because it tells reviewers (and future agents) which divergences are bugs and which are intentional spec-driven deltas. A future contributor might propose 'just diverge to fit contacts better' — the answer is no, divergence is a regression of cookie-cutter intent and is reviewable. The banner SHOULD however prompt a follow-up sweep when JMAP-qz9v.2 / .4 / .15 (contacts /copy mandates, apply_jmap_patch, same-account check) are addressed, because the same gaps exist in calendars-server's /copy paths.
